id.meaning: Same string as the database key; the page warns on a missing or different one.

n.meaning: A stable number the owner answers by.

status.meaning: `open` or `closed`. A closed item is exempt from the form rules.

added.meaning: ISO time the item was added.

ref.meaning: Each id with its plain name.

short.meaning: Optional, 24 characters or fewer: the name on the wide left list. Longer or missing, the list shows `title` cut with an ellipsis.

owner.meaning: The session that reads the answer at its wake.

home.meaning: The step, PR or record the answer goes to. A step is its bare step id, so the roadmap upkeep row can match it.

context.meaning: Plain text, line breaks kept. Holds the question form's lines, the Departs from line and a task's Why yours line.

holds.meaning: One plain sentence: what is stopped until the answer. Puts the item in Blocking. Never on a port item.

by.meaning: An ISO deadline. Puts an item with no `holds` in Upcoming.

stands.meaning: `true` puts the item in the last section, Pick stands.

arbiter.meaning: `true` marks a ruling the arbiter decided.

ruled.meaning: ISO time of the ruling, on an arbiter item.

rank.meaning: Integer, lower first: the order inside a tier. Only the page's writer sets it.

group.meaning: A slug: the frame the item shares with the other items of that group (see `groups/<slug>`).

port.meaning: `true` marks a question about a port or redesign of an existing app; `false` where the word port means something else.

look.meaning: `true` marks a question about how something looks. Every option card with no picture then shows a warning.

designs.meaning: A list of `{slug, label, file}`: the mockups. An option names its picture with `design`.

options.meaning: A decision's list of `{key, label, how, gain, lose}`, plus optional `design`, `differs` and `widens`.

pick.meaning: The key you recommend; a list of keys on a `multi` item. Never names a `widens` option.

multi.meaning: `true`: the options can all be done together; the owner ticks any number.

ranked.meaning: `true`: the owner also puts the ticked options in order. Implies `multi`.

links.meaning: A task's list of `{label, url}`. A step that presses in a web app needs one.

command.meaning: A task's `{powershell, mac}`, two strings, shown in a closed disclosure with a Copy button.

minutes.meaning: A task's time: a number, or text such as `3 min`.

reply.meaning: What the session says back to a comment or a note.

replied.meaning: ISO time the writer last wrote `reply` or changed `waits`. Marks "New reply".

lastAnswer.meaning: The owner's last answer: `{choice, note, at}`, `{done, note, at}` or `{act: "park", note, at}`.

lane.meaning: The receiver's branch slug or tier, set when an answer takes the busy-lane path.

waits.meaning: `{repo, run}` or `{repo, pr}`: set while the item waits on that CI run or PR.
